sloka: दातुमर्हति धर्मात्मा लोकपालो महायशाः ।ईदृषस्य ममाक्षय्या मेकामभयदक्षिणाम् ॥२-६४-४०॥
transliteration: dātumarhati dharmātmā lokapālo mahāyaśāḥ ।īdṛṣasya mamākṣayyā mekāmabhayadakṣiṇām ॥2-64-40॥

translations.english: 'That lord of justice, who is highly renowned, righteous and the guardian of the worlds will grant me one unfailing boon of protection from fear.
